final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department, COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count FROM income JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.department), shares AS (SELECT member_count, CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), compared AS (SELECT member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(member_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - average_share) FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
